dct_description_sm: The HVGRA consists of signficant groundwater recharge areas (SGRA) and includes areas of TRCA that are 100% serviced by Lake Ontario and meet the following criteria. The data is derived from the Average Annual Recharge (mm/yr) found in Chapter 3 of the TRSPA Assessment Report. They are areas where recharge is greater than 215 mm/yr (Tier 3 water budget, 30 year recharge model) and greater than 150 mm/yr (from Tier 1 water budget for the Etobicoke watershed which was not inlcuded in the Tier 3 model).First update/creation of this layer was requested in 2017 by the Hydrogeology group (Kristina Anderson), and replaced an older HVGRA dataset created by Rick Wilson. In 2018 the Tier 3 water balance layers were updated to use a 30 year model run and a revised HVGRA was created at the request of Don Ford. The two previous datasets can be found in the Groundwater archive folder. This update is part of the TRSPA Section 34 Plan Amendments and this layer can be seen mapped in the TRSPA Assessment Report Map titled: Significant Groundwater Recharge Areas using rule of 44 (1) and Threshold by TRSPA Jurisdiction.Original source layer 30 year model run groundwater recharge was provided by Mason Marchildon, Oak Ridges Moraine Groundwater group.
